description: Shows your Claude Code usage (5-hour session and 7-day window) in the status bar, and the monthly spend on accounts billed by money.
command.refresh.title: Claude Usage: Refresh
command.showHistory.title: Claude Usage: Show History
command.showMenu.title: Claude Usage: Show Menu
command.toggleExtendedView.title: Claude Usage: Toggle Extended View
command.muteNotifications.title: Claude Usage: Mute Notifications…
command.unmuteNotifications.title: Claude Usage: Unmute Notifications
command.exportHistory.title: Claude Usage: Export History…
command.copySummary.title: Claude Usage: Copy Usage Summary
command.openSettings.title: Claude Usage: Open Settings
config.windows.description: Which usage windows the status bar, the notifications and the history show.
config.windows.enum.both: Show the 5-hour session and the 7-day window.
config.extendedView.description: Show full labels (Session (5hr), Weekly (7 day), Resets in) in the status bar.
config.indicator.description: How the status bar draws the usage next to the percentage.
config.indicator.enum.ring: A ring that fills up next to each percentage.
config.indicator.enum.bar: A progress bar next to each percentage.
config.barSize.description: Length of the progress bar. Only used when the indicator is bar.
config.showSpend.description: Monthly spend, for accounts billed by money instead of by usage window.
config.showSpend.enum.auto: Show the monthly spend when the account has extra usage enabled with a limit.
config.notifications.description: Show a notification once per window cycle when usage reaches the warning or the critical threshold.
config.criticalModal.description: Show the critical notification as a modal dialog in the middle of the window, which blocks VS Code until it is closed. Needs notifications to be on.
config.warningThreshold.description: Percentage from which the status bar turns yellow. Must be lower than the critical threshold.
config.criticalThreshold.description: Percentage from which the status bar turns red.
config.historyChartSize.description: Size of the panels of Claude Usage: Show History.
config.historyChartSize.enum.small: Short panels, with a line on the percent axis every 25 points.
config.historyChartSize.enum.medium: Taller panels, with a line every 20 points.
config.historyChartSize.enum.large: The tallest panels, with a line every 10 points.
